verses.en: For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;
verses.pt: Pois quero que saibais quão grande luta tenho por vós, e pelos que estão em Laodicéia, e por quantos não viram a minha pessoa;
verses.en_web: For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you, and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;
verses.en_bbe: For it is my desire to give you news of the great fight I am making for you and for those at Laodicea, and for all who have not seen my face in the flesh;

verses.en: That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;
verses.pt: para que os seus corações sejam animados, estando unidos em amor, e enriquecidos da plenitude do entendimento para o pleno conhecimento do mistério de Deus - Cristo,
verses.en_web: that their hearts may be comforted, they being knit together in love, and gaining all riches of the full assurance of understanding, that they may know the mystery of God, both of the Father and of Christ,
verses.en_bbe: So that their hearts may be comforted, and that being joined together in love, they may come to the full wealth of the certain knowledge of the secret of God, even Christ,

verses.en: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
verses.pt: no qual estão escondidos todos os tesouros da sabedoria e da ciência.
verses.en_web: in whom are all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge hidden.
verses.en_bbe: In whom are all the secret stores of wisdom and knowledge.

verses.en: And this I say, lest any man should beguile you with enticing words.
verses.pt: Digo isto, para que ninguém vos engane com palavras persuasivas.
verses.en_web: Now this I say that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.
verses.en_bbe: I say this so that you may not be turned away by any deceit of words.

verses.en: For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ.
verses.pt: Porque ainda que eu esteja ausente quanto ao corpo, contudo em espírito estou convosco, regozijando-me, e vendo a vossa ordem e a firmeza da vossa fé em Cristo.
verses.en_web: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, rejoicing and seeing your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.
verses.en_bbe: For though I am not present in the flesh, still I am with you in the spirit, seeing with joy your order, and your unchanging faith in Christ.

verses.en: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him:
verses.pt: Portanto, assim como recebestes a Cristo Jesus, o Senhor, assim também nele andai,
verses.en_web: As therefore you received Christ Jesus, the Lord, walk in him,
verses.en_bbe: As, then, you took Christ Jesus the Lord, so go on in him,

verses.en: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.
verses.pt: arraigados e edificados nele, e confirmados na fé, assim como fostes ensinados, abundando em ação de graças.
verses.en_web: rooted and built up in him, and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.
verses.en_bbe: Rooted and based together in him, strong in the faith which the teaching gave you, giving praise to God at all times.

verses.en: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.
verses.pt: Tendo cuidado para que ninguém vos faça presa sua, por meio de filosofias e vãs sutilezas, segundo a tradição dos homens, segundo os rudimentos do mundo, e não segundo Cristo;
verses.en_web: Be careful that you don’t let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elements of the world, and not after Christ.
verses.en_bbe: Take care that no one takes you away by force, through man's wisdom and deceit, going after the beliefs of men and the theories of the world, and not after Christ:

verses.en: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.
verses.pt: porque nele habita corporalmente toda a plenitude da divindade,
verses.en_web: For in him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily,
verses.en_bbe: For in him all the wealth of God's being has a living form,

verses.en: And ye are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:
verses.pt: e tendes a vossa plenitude nele, que é a cabeça de todo principado e potestade,
verses.en_web: and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power;
verses.en_bbe: And you are complete in him, who is the head of all rule and authority:

verses.en: In whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ:
verses.pt: no qual também fostes circuncidados com a circuncisão não feita por mãos no despojar do corpo da carne, a saber, a circuncisão de Cristo;
verses.en_web: in whom you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the sins of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ;
verses.en_bbe: In whom you had a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ;

verses.en: Buried with him in baptism, wherein also ye are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God, who hath raised him from the dead.
verses.pt: tendo sido sepultados com ele no batismo, no qual também fostes ressuscitados pela fé no poder de Deus, que o ressuscitou dentre os mortos;
verses.en_web: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.
verses.en_bbe: Having been put to death with him in baptism, by which you came to life again with him, through faith in the working of God, who made him come back from the dead.

verses.en: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;
verses.pt: e a vós, quando estáveis mortos nos vossos delitos e na incircuncisão da vossa carne, vos vivificou juntamente com ele, perdoando-nos todos os delitos;
verses.en_web: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses,
verses.en_bbe: And you, being dead through your sins and the evil condition of your flesh, to you, I say, he gave life together with him, and forgiveness of all our sins;

verses.en: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;
verses.pt: e havendo riscado o escrito de dívida que havia contra nós nas suas ordenanças, o qual nos era contrário, removeu-o do meio de nós, cravando-o na cruz;
verses.en_web: wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us; and he has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross;
verses.en_bbe: Having put an end to the handwriting of the law which was against us, taking it out of the way by nailing it to his cross;

verses.en: And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
verses.pt: e, tendo despojado os principados e potestades, os exibiu publicamente e deles triunfou na mesma cruz.
verses.en_web: having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
verses.en_bbe: Having made himself free from the rule of authorities and powers, he put them openly to shame, glorying over them in it.

verses.en: Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days:
verses.pt: Ninguém, pois, vos julgue pelo comer, ou pelo beber, ou por causa de dias de festa, ou de lua nova, ou de sábados,
verses.en_web: Let no one therefore judge you in eating, or in drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day,
verses.en_bbe: For this reason let no man be your judge in any question of food or drink or feast days or new moons or Sabbaths:

verses.en: Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ.
verses.pt: que são sombras das coisas vindouras; mas o corpo é de Cristo.
verses.en_web: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ’s.
verses.en_bbe: For these are an image of the things which are to come; but the body is Christ's.

verses.en: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
verses.pt: Ninguém atue como árbitro contra vós, afetando humildade ou culto aos anjos, firmando-se em coisas que tenha visto, inchado vãmente pelo seu entendimento carnal,
verses.en_web: Let no one rob you of your prize by a voluntary humility and worshiping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
verses.en_bbe: Let no man take your reward from you by consciously making little of himself and giving worship to angels; having his thoughts fixed on the things which he has seen, being foolishly lifted up in his natural mind,

verses.en: And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of God.
verses.pt: e não retendo a Cabeça, da qual todo o corpo, provido e organizado pelas juntas e ligaduras, vai crescendo com o aumento concedido por Deus.
verses.en_web: and not holding firmly to the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and ligaments, grows with God’s growth.
verses.en_bbe: And not joined to the Head, from whom all the body, being given strength and kept together through its joins and bands, has its growth with the increase of God.

verses.en: Wherefore if ye be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances,
verses.pt: Se morrestes com Cristo quanto aos rudimentos do mundo, por que vos sujeitais ainda a ordenanças, como se vivêsseis no mundo,
verses.en_web: If you died with Christ from the elements of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves to ordinances,
verses.en_bbe: If you were made free, by your death with Christ, from the rules of the world, why do you put yourselves under the authority of orders

verses.en: (Touch not; taste not; handle not;
verses.pt: tais como: não toques, não proves, não manuseies
verses.en_web: “Don’t handle, nor taste, nor touch”
verses.en_bbe: Which say there may be no touching, tasting, or taking in your hands,

verses.en: Which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men?
verses.pt: (as quais coisas todas hão de perecer pelo uso), segundo os preceitos e doutrinas dos homens?
verses.en_web: (all of which perish with use), according to the precepts and doctrines of men?
verses.en_bbe: (Rules which are all to come to an end with their use) after the orders and teaching of men?

verses.en: Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body; not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh.
verses.pt: As quais têm, na verdade, alguma aparência de sabedoria em culto voluntário, humildade fingida, e severidade para com o corpo, mas não têm valor algum no combate contra a satisfação da carne.
verses.en_web: Which things indeed appear like wisdom in self-imposed worship, and humility, and severity to the body; but aren’t of any value against the indulgence of the flesh.
verses.en_bbe: These things seem to have a sort of wisdom in self-ordered worship and making little of oneself, and being cruel to the body, not honouring it by giving it its natural use.
